director.name: 莱赫·科瓦尔斯基 Lech Kowalski

introduction: On September 29th, 2008, a new kind of documentary was launched on the Internet (www.camerawar.tv) and after then, every Monday, new film chapters of varying lengths, have been posted online. Every film chapter, in and of itself, is a short documentary but when viewed together, whether chronologically or in arbitrary sequences, tells a story. This is a new kind of cinema in a new venue, a cinema free of television and corporate production restraints.
